التمسوا (form VIII)
# اِلْتَمَسُوا (iltamasū) /il.ta.ma.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# اُلْتُمِسُوا (ultumisū) /ul.tu.mi.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# اِلْتَمِسُوا (iltamisū) /il.ta.mi.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
